briefdescription.para: Convenience alias for the id-only payload used by get-services lookups.

detaileddescription.para: This header defines the User entity for the "users" table. It inherits all the validated Client behaviour (create/update with validation, suspend/activate, username checks) and adds one small query, getSqlGetServicesStatement, which simply selects the user's own id. Despite the method name, it does not join the organisation tables the way Provider's version does.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Controllers construct User whenever they need to work with an ordinary user account, reusing the safe Client builders for CRUD and suspension. The added id-lookup statement provides a minimal get-services answer for users. Without this class there would be no User-specific table binding for the account endpoints.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
std::optional: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/utility/optional
SQL parameter binding: put $1, $2, ... markers in the SQL and pass the real values separately; see https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp or the libpqxx documentation.
Type alias (using Data_t = ...): a short local name for a longer qualified type; no new type is created.
